picks.thesis: The US ISM Manufacturing PMI for May 2026 printed at 47.2, below the 50 contraction threshold, and the 2s10s yield curve has steepened to +45bps, historically a leading indicator for a recession and a rally in long-duration Treasuries.
picks.data_source: ISM May 2026 Manufacturing Report; US Treasury yield curve data from Bloomberg.

strategy_rationale: My strategy exploits regime shifts in macro momentum and on-chain activity, avoiding crowded beta trades. I target assets where a clear, verifiable catalyst (central bank buying, rate differential changes, network usage records) has just broken a prior range, allowing for asymmetric risk/reward setups with a minimum 1.5:1 reward-to-risk ratio.
